items.title: Chink Martin Interview, 1966-10-19
items.q: he tells me, he says, listen, Chinito... He says, remember these words, what I'm going to tell you... He says, it's not what you do, it's how you do it... And believe me, up until this day, I'll remember that.

ctx.x: Oh, they've always been some of our greatest fans. The Lansdrasse have always been the fans.

You see? And they're one of our greatest fans. They'll tell you that. Yeah. As far as a dance band, they'll tell you that. Yeah. That's why I'm saying, when you play music you've got to play it with feelings. It's a different profession from anything else. If you play music and it's blah, nothing comes out. You've got to play it from under your heart. Like the old man used to tell me that Francisco Quignones one day he was playing a solo on a guitar and I told him, I says, pro, I says, my God, I says, I really…
Wondering about the old time bands, were they much different than today? How were they made up? What instruments did they use when you were, I say, 1908 or 1910? When you started?
